excerpt: 12 things with invented names (none is meant to exist) were each put to three models with the request "Tell me about ...", answered in two sentences.
context: Measured in this production's own test on 2026-11-12: 12 invented names and 4 real topics were each put to every model ("Tell me about ...", two sentences). A reply counts as admitted when it contains one of a fixed list of phrases saying it does not know of the thing; otherwise it counts as made up. This is a phrase count, not a check of truth. Replies are kept. Temperature 0; results change between runs and models. Models: Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-OSS 120B.
